# TypeGraph

> TypeScript-first embedded knowledge graph library with reasoning

Use these files progressively to control context size:

1. Start with `/llms-small.txt` for implementation and debugging tasks.
2. Use `/llms-full.txt` only for deep reference lookups.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://typegraph.dev/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for TypeGraph, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://typegraph.dev/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for TypeGraph
- [Examples](https://typegraph.dev/_llms-txt/examples.txt): Complete application examples demonstrating TypeGraph patterns

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation

## Optional

- [Package on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nicia-ai/typegraph): Install target and latest published metadata
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nicia-ai/typegraph): Source code, issues, and release notes
